webster.text: Not defensible; not vindicable; not justifiable; illegal; unjust; improper.

example.quote: It has led this state, on one occasion, to raise the expectations of pubhc creditors, and to sink them again, by an unwarrantable breach of faith.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, July 1, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
